objective: M1 tier A under docs/m1-criteria.md section 8 as amended after EXP-048 session 1 and again after EXP-051 session 1 (KI-45): the same question as EXP-048, can the player character's world position be observed reproducibly from the pinned GOG build's own text files, read read-only, while network monitoring covers the whole run?
hypothesis: Tier A INCONCLUSIVE / NO DATA, with no_data_established true: no permitted file contains the position (F-ENV-014; EXP-048 session 1 found none in the 6 files it could read). This is an expectation fixed before the run, not a result. The session gates are expected to hold as they did in EXP-048 session 1. No expectation is predeclared for the network verdict: any contact by the game is a FAIL. NO DATA means that no new line matched the candidate rule of docs/m1-criteria.md section 8 (an ASCII label followed within 12 characters that are not digits, signs or decimal points (+, -, .) by a number, or in a Windows-1252 read any non-ASCII line naming pos or loc), not that the files hold no position in any form.
environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, Python 3.15, logman and tracerpt from Windows; the owner's pinned GOG set (D-008 amended), launched directly with GOG Galaxy and Steam closed
procedure: The owner approved the second amendment in chat on 2026-10-29 ("Aprovo"), first as of a8f5d5a and then, after tools/m1/tier_a.py's label was changed to EXPERIMENT = "EXP-060", again as of c4e9cce ("Aprovo"). Any later change to section 8 or the session tools needs a new approval. EXP-050 and the dry run passed elevated on the streamed analysis on 2026-10-29 (clean 7126ff0, code f1665ae). Identical to EXP-051's procedure (python -I tools/m1/tier_a.py --session N, elevated, saves copied aside offline, GOG Galaxy and Steam closed, no KI-35 run at the same time), with only the second amendment: netwatch streams the decoded trace one event at a time, counts only the root's own events, closes the file on every path and keeps only counts per PID, with the same result as before for tracerpt output; session.json is labelled EXP-060. Any FAIL or other INCONCLUSIVE stops the series and goes back to the owner.
